value: Study analyzed >6,500 metagenomes from 36 datasets across 6 continents and 25 countries
Reconstructed 1,023 P. copri genomes: 17 isolates and 1,006 MAGs
Four distinct P. copri clades (A, B, C, D) with >10% inter-clade genetic divergence
Clade delineation time estimated ~6.5 mya (split of clade B) to ~2.5-3.5 mya for other clades
All four clades predate human migration out of Africa (~90-194 ka)
Ancient DNA analysis: P. copri detected in 5,300-year-old Iceman and pre-Columbian coprolites
New sequencing: 272 metagenomes from Ghana, Ethiopia, Tanzania, Madagascar (98 additional genomes)
Intra-family strain sharing observed in 5 of 26 cases (19.2%)
No clear association of P. copri clades with disease phenotypes in meta-analysis
Substantial functional diversity in carbohydrate metabolism between clades
Clade B notably depleted in succinate production genes and β-galactosidase
uncurated_metadata.evidence_quote: Analysis of >1,000 P. copri genomes reveals four clades; P. copri began to diversify ~6.5 million years ago
uncurated_metadata.notes: Additional contextual metadata about study scope, evolutionary history, and functional findings
